item.title: Ditch the Generic Resume Phrases 🚫 • Use: “I increased sales by 20% in 6 months.” • Quantify achievements with numbers and timeframes. • Highlight unique skills and experiences. • Tailor each resume to the specific job. • Focus on results, not duties. 🎯 How can you better quantify your achievements on your resume? #resume #jobsearch #ScalePilot #SocialPilot #AIAutomations
